text: PPRD East table-top exercise, with AI support. One phone plays every role: the Director, the Mayor, the Fire Commander and Regional Civil Protection.
caption: PPRD East table-top exercise, with AI support. One phone plays every role: the Director, the Mayor, the Fire Commander and Regional Civil Protection.

text: Each player picks a language. Regional Civil Protection will play in Armenian.
caption: Each player picks a language. Regional Civil Protection will play in Armenian.

text: The Director starts the exercise. Day 1, 13:00: a wildfire is burning on Pine Hill.
caption: The Director starts the exercise. Day 1, 13:00: a wildfire is burning on Pine Hill.

text: The Director sends the first injects from the exercise script. The AI translates each one for its recipient.
caption: The Director sends the first injects from the exercise script. The AI translates each one for its recipient.

text: The Mayor receives the injects in Italian: the fire, and 120 pupils at Pineta Primary School.
caption: The Mayor receives the injects in Italian: the fire, and 120 pupils at Pineta Primary School.

text: The Mayor answers in Italian, in their own words.
caption: The Mayor answers in Italian, in their own words.

text: The Fire Commander orders fire lines using zone codes from the map grid, and an air-tanker drop.
caption: The Fire Commander orders fire lines using zone codes from the map grid, and an air-tanker drop.

text: The AI turns each reply into commands, and the simulator checks every command against the role's authority and resources.
caption: The AI turns each reply into commands, and the simulator checks every command against the role's authority and resources.

text: It flags a real constraint: evacuating 120 pupils needs 3 buses, but the Mayor has only 2.
caption: It flags a real constraint: evacuating 120 pupils needs 3 buses, but the Mayor has only 2.

text: The Director writes an AI prompt: one extra bus for the Mayor, confirmed by an inject.
caption: The Director writes an AI prompt: one extra bus for the Mayor, confirmed by an inject.

text: The Director reviews the AI's proposal, a resource change plus an inject draft, and approves it.
caption: The Director reviews the AI's proposal, a resource change plus an inject draft, and approves it.

text: The Fire Commander's orders are approved, with a note to the player.
caption: The Fire Commander's orders are approved, with a note to the player.

text: And the Mayor's orders now pass: 3 buses for 120 pupils.
caption: And the Mayor's orders now pass: 3 buses for 120 pupils.

text: The Mayor gets exercise control's feedback in Italian.
caption: The Mayor gets exercise control's feedback in Italian.

text: The Director resolves turn 1: thirty simulated minutes, played live on the big screen at 120 times speed.
caption: The Director resolves turn 1: thirty simulated minutes, played live on the big screen at 120 times speed.

text: Flame length follows the fire's intensity and the share of Monte Carlo runs that burn each cell. The glow ahead is where only some runs reach.
caption: Flame length follows the fire's intensity and the share of Monte Carlo runs that burn each cell. The glow ahead is where only some runs reach.

text: The fire lines are cut, the air tanker drops, and the school is evacuated to the sports centre.
caption: The fire lines are cut, the air tanker drops, and the school is evacuated to the sports centre.

text: Every player gets an AI-written situation update for their role.
caption: Every player gets an AI-written situation update for their role.

text: Turn 2. The Director escalates: a wind warning, then commands by code, raising the wind to 55 km/h and starting a new fire in zone G5.
caption: Turn 2. The Director escalates: a wind warning, then commands by code, raising the wind to 55 km/h and starting a new fire in zone G5.

text: Regional Civil Protection reads the wind warning in Armenian, and asks for international assistance through the EU Civil Protection Mechanism.
caption: Regional Civil Protection reads the wind warning in Armenian, and asks for international assistance through the EU Civil Protection Mechanism.

text: A vague order from the Fire Commander…
caption: A vague order from the Fire Commander…

text: …gets a clarification question from the AI instead of a guess.
caption: …gets a clarification question from the AI instead of a guess.

text: The Fire Commander answers precisely.
caption: The Fire Commander answers precisely.

text: The Director rejects the vague order, and approves the assistance request and the precise fire lines.
caption: The Director rejects the vague order, and approves the assistance request and the precise fire lines.

text: Turn 2 resolves live: sixty minutes. Reinforcements arrive, the lines protect Pineta, and the new fire spreads through the farmland.
caption: Turn 2 resolves live: sixty minutes. Reinforcements arrive, the lines protect Pineta, and the new fire spreads through the farmland.

text: Every inject, reply, AI interpretation, decision and consequence is logged for the debrief. Humans decide; the AI mediates.
caption: Every inject, reply, AI interpretation, decision and consequence is logged for the debrief. Humans decide; the AI mediates.
